text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with dark hair in two ornamental buns and soft fringe, warm brown eyes, a softly rounded oval face and coral rose lips. Small floral hair ornaments, dangling earrings, coral and teal traditional fantasy robes with ivory panels and delicate metallic embroidery. Complete modest floor-length coral, ivory and teal embroidered hanfu-inspired dress with a continuous layered flowing SKIRT, wide sleeves, teal waist sash, gold floral fastenings, ivory embroidered flat shoe tips visible beneath hem. No pants. Tall slender 173 cm. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 7.8-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text. Tall elegant female fashion-model anatomy with approximately 7.8 anatomical head lengths from skull crown to bare-foot soles. Head including skull but excluding hair volume is about 12.8% of total standing body height, visibly smaller relative to the body than a 6–7-head figure. Long naturally proportioned legs and arms, normal-length neck, natural shoulder width and pelvis. Do not elongate her face or neck or merely enlarge shoes. Straight camera with no foreshortening. Keep all ornamental hairpieces and entire gown hem inside canvas with margins; garment length and structure identical in all views.
